name: singlet_grn_differential_grn_rewiring
title: Differential GRN and co-expression rewiring between two conditions
description: Tests which gene pairs, TF-target edges or regulon activities change their dependence between two conditions beyond their mean expression change, with donors as the unit of replication. The default method cscore estimates cell-type-specific co-expression per condition from raw UMI counts and calibrates the difference by permuting donor labels. Use regulon_limma, module_preservation or edge_diff as comparators rather than as the primary rewiring call. Do not use it with cells as replicates or with fewer than four donors per group.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Rewiring estimator; cscore is the default and calibrates pair differences by donor permutation.

sample_key.description: obs column with the donor or biological sample id; the unit of permutation and replication.

condition_key.description: obs column with exactly two levels; the difference is level two minus level one.

celltype_key.description: obs column; estimation runs separately within each level. Required for cscore.

genes.description: Gene subset for pair methods; null takes the top 1000 genes by mean relative abundance per cell.

cscore.description: Options for cscore; ignored by the other methods.

n_permu.description: Donor-label permutations; capped at the number of distinct donor partitions.

irls_n_iter.description: Maximum IRLS iterations in the moment regression.

irls_eps.description: IRLS convergence threshold on abs(log(theta / theta_prev)).

covariates.description: Cell-level metadata columns adjusted in the moment regression.

regulon_limma.description: Options for regulon_limma; ignored by the other methods.

prior_network.description: Signed prior used to build regulons; should differ from the evaluation prior.

min_targets.description: Minimum regulon targets present in the layer for a regulon to be scored.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for donor-label permutations and for stochastic GRN fits.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory, number of model fits and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/rewiring_cscore_edges. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_donors_per_group, n_tested, n_q_le_0_05 (BH q at most 0.05), top (ten strongest rows). Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, model_fits, device.
